items.anchor_text: Mwanamume mwenye umri wa miaka 57 anapokea tiba ya mionzi ya saratani ya sell ya mapafu. Licha ya matibabu, ukubwa wa uvimbe huongezeka polepole, na hufa miezi 6 baadaye. Seli zake za uvimbe zina mabadiliko katika jeni ya p53 (TP53), na kusababisha bidhaa ya jeni isiyofanya kazi. Kulingana na ugunduzi huu, ukuaji wa uvimbe unaoendelea licha ya tiba ya mionzi una uwezekano mkubwa wa kuhusishwa na kasoro katika kukamatwa kwa mzunguko wa seli katika awamu zipi kati ya zifuatazo za mzunguko wa seli? A) G0 B) G1 C) G2 D) M
items.english_text: A 57-year-old man receives radiation therapy for a squamous cell carcinoma of the lung. Despite therapy, the tumor progressively increases in size, and he dies 6 months later. His tumor cells contain a point mutation in the p53 gene (TP53), leading to an inactive gene product. Based on this finding, the progressive tumor growth despite irradiation therapy is most likely to be related to a defect in cell cycle arrest in which of the following phases of the cell cycle? A) G0 B) G1 C) G2 D) M
